svg.title: How deep a parent listens
svg.desc: Updates climb one level; the root looks deeper on demand; a grandchild escalates directly when the premise breaks; the root re-scopes through the branch owner.

text.tspan: Each node hears from the nodes it asked. Their updates already summarize their own children.
So updates climb one level at a time: the leaves report to Demand,
and Demand reports to the root.
When the root wants detail, it looks deeper itself. Looking is a read, not a subscription.
Lead times finds the premise is wrong. That's worth skipping a level:
it tells the root directly, and Demand too.
The root re-scopes through the branch's owner, and Demand steers its own children.
